# Arnel Baylon — Context Engineer & Full-Stack Software Developer

> Portfolio, engineering context, and architectural index for Arnel A. Baylon: Context Engineer, Full-Stack Software Developer, and Autonomous AI Agent Architect.

Arnel Baylon is a software engineer specializing in modern full-stack web applications, agentic AI workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and enterprise business systems.

## Flagship Systems & Featured Projects
- [Pixel Crew](https://github.com/hiroqt): Autonomous 23-agent software engineering swarm with an anti-slop design engine, static codebase analysis, and real-time visual dashboard
- [sakto.ka](https://github.com/hiroqt): Stateless AI career copilot, ATS resume studio scoring 90%+ on enterprise ATS parsers (Workday, Lever), and STAR interview prep engine
- [FinOps AI Dashboard](https://github.com/hiroqt): Cloud financial operations and cost anomaly detection platform; Winner of Best Business Impact at AWS BGC
- [eBuddy](https://github.com/hiroqt): Agentic citizen public service assistant unifying civic inquiries; developed for the 2026 Philippine eGov Hackathon
- [Better Trece Martires](https://bettertrece.vercel.app): Civic open data platform and municipal budget transparency explorer with interactive visualizations
- [Momo](https://github.com/hiroqt/momo): AI study platform that turns uploaded class files into source-grounded flashcards, quizzes, and practice exams, with an offline-first Expo app and a FastAPI + pgvector RAG backend
- [VCM HRIS](https://github.com/hiroqt): Enterprise HR management platform with QR-code vicinity attendance validation, statutory deduction computation, and automated payroll
- [Present Po](https://github.com/hiroqt): Mobile workforce time-tracking solution with geofencing attendance validation and automated daily shift reporting
- [PaceMentor](https://github.com/hiroqt): AI running coach companion integrating Strava activity tracking and personalized dynamic periodization plans
- [Tearsize](https://github.com/hiroqt): High-performance e-commerce storefront with mobile-first checkout and automated inventory synchronization
